verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a first-party Export API that creates date-ranged exports across many data types: customers, customer screening, screening and monitoring cases, profiles, payment screening cases, transaction monitoring cases and alerts, and transactions. Transaction data can be exported as CSV, and case audit trails and other resources are retrievable via a documented OpenAPI schema. However, an open file format is only evidenced for transactions, download URLs expire after 5 seconds, and nothing covers exporting configurations or risk-scoring setups or offboarding and deletion. missing for 10: documented open file formats for every export type, evidence that exports cover all account data (configurations, risk equations, audit logs in bulk), a documented account exit or data-deletion process, independent hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
